0:
cache:
  enabled: true
  dir: /data/cache
  port: 8088
  proxy_port: 8089
container:
  docker_host: "-"
  workdir_parent: shared/workdir
host:
  workdir_parent: /data/act
kubernetes:
  namespace: forgejo
  poll_timeout: 10m
log:
  level: info
plugins:
  k8s:
    address: "unix:///plugin/forgejo-runner-k8s.sock"
    options:
      namespace: forgejo
      poll_timeout: 10m
      labels: "app.kubernetes.io/name=forgejo-runner-instance,egress.home.arpa/custom-egress=true"
      resources: |
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 256Mi
        limits:
          memory: 1Gi
runner:
  capacity: 3
  labels:
    - ubuntu-latest:k8s:/config/podspec-default.yaml
    - default:k8s:/config/podspec-default.yaml
    - docker:k8s:/config/podspec-dind.yaml
    - multiarch:k8s:/config/podspec-dind.yaml  # you need binfmt-misc extension for multiarch
  timeout: 3h
  shutdown_timeout: 3m

containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:175bb41fcb7d53a1316bc1288aa20f07d68f3394650177bdc88462bf87054036
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 4Gi
nodeSelector:
  kubernetes.io/hostname: kharkiv
restartPolicy: Never

initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    args:
      - --ipv6
      - --fixed-cidr-v6=fd00:d1d::/64
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:175bb41fcb7d53a1316bc1288aa20f07d68f3394650177bdc88462bf87054036
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 4Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
nodeSelector:
  kubernetes.io/hostname: kharkiv
restartPolicy: Never

echo "🚀 Starting Offsite Sync to Google Drive..."

cp /config-ro/rclone.conf /tmp/rclone.conf
chmod 600 /tmp/rclone.conf

rclone sync /data/backups/homeassistant gdrive:homeassistant-backups \
  --transfers 16 \
  --checkers 16 \
  --fast-list \
  --delete-after \
  --log-level INFO \
  --stats 1m \
  --retries 3
echo "✅ Offsite Sync Complete!"

[couchdb]
single_node=true
max_document_size = 50000000

[chttpd]
require_valid_user_except_for_up = true
max_http_request_size = 4294967296
enable_cors = true

[chttpd_auth]
require_valid_user = true

[httpd]
WWW-Authenticate = Basic realm="couchdb"
bind_address = 0.0.0.0

[cors]
credentials = true
headers = accept, authorization, content-type, origin, referer
methods = GET, PUT, POST, HEAD, DELETE
origins = app://obsidian.md, capacitor://localhost, http://localhost

unifi-mcp.ewatkins.dev, unifi-network-mcp, unifi-network-mcp:3000, unifi-network-mcp.mcp.svc.cluster.local, unifi-network-mcp.mcp.svc.cluster.local:3000, localhost, localhost:3000, 127.0.0.1, 127.0.0.1:3000
